rows.en:
(I'm happy for her, but it also feels like
Ranka's gone somewhere far away,
and that's a little lonely...)
Oh, \p-kun!
Huh? Ranka!

What a coincidence!
I'm so happy I ran into you here!

Yeah, I'm happy to see you too, but...
You're out here without even a disguise.
You've got to remember you're famous now...

It's fine!
I'm not that big yet, so it's no problem.
rows.notes: Ranka, both genders. 'watashi nante mada mada' = she is nowhere near famous yet.

rows.en:
(With this many Ranka posters on display,
I really don't think that's true...)

Hey, isn't that Ranka-chan...?
Think she'd give me an autograph?
Kyaaa! She's even cuter in person~!

Ranka, you'd better get out of here
before this turns into a big scene...

Y-yeah, looks like it.
See you, \p-kun!

(Even as a star,
Ranka's still Ranka after all.)

(I'm happy for her, but it also feels like
Ranka-chan's gone somewhere far away,
and that's a little lonely...)
Oh, \p-chan!
Huh? Ranka-chan!

Yeah, I'm happy to see you too, but...
You're out here without even a disguise.
You've got to remember you're famous now...

(With this many Ranka-chan posters on display,
I really don't think that's true...)

Ranka-chan, you'd better get out of here
before this turns into a big scene...

Y-yeah, looks like it.
See you, \p-chan!

(Even as a star, Ranka-chan
is still Ranka-chan after all.)

Sorry...
I'm kind of causing trouble for everyone...
rows.notes: Ranka, both genders. Brera is following her around as bodyguard (c15777).

rows.en: Seriously, it's no problem.

(Though it's a little unnerving having him stand
behind us all class with that blank face...)
rows.notes: PLAYER, both genders. 'him' = Brera, male in glossary.

rows.en:
Oh, but Brera-san is a really nice person!
When my recording wasn't going well,
he cheered me up.

So I hope he can get along with Alto-kun
and the others too, but...
Ranka, it's time for your recording.

Okay, Brera-san.
See you, \p-kun.

(I hope he gets along with Alto,
but there's probably no way that'll happen...)
Really, it's no problem.

Okay, Brera-san.
See you, \p-chan.

(I hope he gets along with Saotome-kun,
but there's probably no way that'll happen...)
rows.notes: Female; she calls Alto Saotome-kun as in the Japanese.

rows.en: (Okay, where should I go to have fun today...)

Huh? Isn't that Ranka?
What's with the big hurry?

I got my part-time shift time mixed up,
so if I don't hurry, I'm gonna be late.
Yikes, that's bad.

Yeah, it is...
Sigh~ Why am I such a klutz...?

Um, sorry to interrupt while you're feeling down,
but, Ranka...
What is it, \p-kun?

Didn't you need to hurry so you wouldn't
be late for your part-time job?

Ah!
S-see you later, \p-kun!
(Ha ha, Ranka really is a scatterbrain.)
(Okay, where should I go to have fun today...)

Huh? Isn't that Ranka-chan?
What's with the big hurry?
Oh no, that's bad.

Um, sorry to interrupt while you're feeling down,
but, Ranka-chan...
What is it, \p-chan?

Ah!
S-see you later, \p-chan!
(Hee hee, Ranka-chan really is a scatterbrain.)

(Taking a different way home like this
once in a while isn't so bad.)

(Hm? I hear singing...
Wait, is that Ranka?)
(Wow~ She's really good...)

Oh, \p-kun...
...Were you watching me sing, by any chance?

Yeah, sorry.
But wow, you were really good.

I really love singing,
and I hope that someday I can be like Sheryl...

You can do it, Ranka.
I guarantee it.

Thanks! Even if it's just flattery,
it makes me super happy.
rows.notes: Ranka, both genders, twice per version. 'flattery' kept: the player's closing thought answers it.

rows.en:
Oh, it's almost time for my part-time job!
See you!

(Hmm... I wasn't trying to flatter her
or anything, though...)

(Taking a different way home like this
once in a while isn't so bad.)

(Hm? I hear singing...
Wait, is that Ranka-chan?)
(Wow~ She's really good...)

Oh, \p-chan...
...Were you watching me sing, by any chance?

Yeah, sorry.
But wow, you were really good.

You can do it, Ranka-chan.
I guarantee it.

(Hmm... I wasn't trying to flatter her
or anything, though...)
